rationale: This is BnBuddy's highest-authority page in the guidebook space. Currently positions BnBuddy as a paid SaaS product, but the business has pivoted — guidebooks are now free and the core business is co-hosting/management. The page needs to reflect this pivot, improve keyword targeting, and capture comparison/alternative queries that are currently going to competitors.

competitors.notes: Ranking well for 'airbnb welcome book template free'. Comprehensive listicle with 7 options. Promotes SmoothStay's free tier.

Comprehensive guide on what to include in a welcome book. Promotes Operto Guest.
